_note: An Expedition (docs/ROADBOOK.md): stages done in order by driving to real places (lat/lon on the map). Stage types: reach (get to a place; marker shown), clue (get to a place from a clue: no marker until within revealWithin metres; hint after hintAfterMin minutes), collect (pick up every item: drive within radius of each, any order), checkpoints (a timed run through them in order: starts at the first, timeLimitSec to the last; failing starts it again). finale: true on the last. Each stage pays its points and tokens once. party: how many drive it together (1: solo; co-op later). timeOfDay: the hour (0–24, 0 midnight) the player's world is set to while the Expedition is under way (not during races); a stage's own timeOfDay wins for that stage; leave it out for the player's own time.
name: The Midnight Run
blurb: A text from a number you don't know: "Airport car park. Midnight. Come alone." Somebody's running the hills tonight, and they want to see what you've got.

stages.name: The meeting spot
stages.text: Get to the Adelaide Airport long-term car park. Look for the headlights.

stages.name: Follow the clue
stages.text: Nobody's there. Just a note under your wiper.
stages.clue: "Where the city crosses the river on stone, the crew left their mark. Drive over it."
stages.hint: Head into the city and cross the River Torrens on King William Road.

stages.name: The flyers
stages.text: Somebody's been taping flyers to the poles along The Parade. Grab all three before they're gone.

items.name: Flyer at the top of The Parade

stages.name: The hill run
stages.text: The flyers say it all: Greenhill Road, bottom to the bend above the quarry. Make it in time and they'll tell you where the real crowd is.

stages.name: The lookout
stages.text: Mount Lofty Summit. The whole city's lights below you, and a crowd of cars that just watched you arrive.
